lessons.claim: ★ Viscoelasticity (memory and elasticity) comes entirely from the thermodynamic component -- in creeping flow the hydrodynamic stress is a linear function of the instantaneous velocity gradient, so it becomes exactly 0 the moment the flow is cut off. So for a degree of freedom to produce elasticity it needs all three of (1) a preferred equilibrium configuration (2) a restoring mechanism resisting that deformation mode (3) tau_c*|E|=O(1). A degree of freedom with no restoring mechanism does not contribute to the stress -- our DLVO chain coming out at 0.996x the dissipation (= the bead alone) is an instance of this theorem
